User.title: User
User.description: An operator or administrator accessing the Pipe Quality Tracker application.

username.description: The human-readable username used to log in.

role.description: The access level of the user.

password.description: The encrypted or plaintext password credential.

PipeRecord.title: Pipe Record
PipeRecord.description: The full design specifications, production steps, QA validation checks, and ejection parameters of a pipe.

operatorId.description: The user ID of the initiating operator.

operatorUsername.description: The user name of the initiating operator.

steps.description: A dynamic dictionary keyed by production step numbers (1-8).

isDispatched.description: Whether the pipe has been dispatched for delivery.

dispatchedBy.description: Username of the director who dispatched the pipe.

ToleranceConfig.title: Tolerance Configuration
ToleranceConfig.description: Dimensional threshold limits for step validations.

ProjectConfig.title: Project Configuration
ProjectConfig.description: Pre-defined active production codes and references lists.

ChatMessage.title: Chat Message
ChatMessage.description: Communication logs entered on the operator shift team workspace bulletin.

/users/{userId}.description: Dynamic workspace directories keeping verified operators.

/pipes/{pipeId}.description: The primary GRP/GRE pipe manufacturing record index.

/tolerances/{toleranceId}.description: Target threshold tolerance rules for active manufacturing series.
